title: chat-vtc-server: chat-bound call access helper
description: VtcBackend §Per-call access (494e757e) makes the backend's reads hide calls the caller cannot access. For chat-bound calls, draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00 (6bcd9d8) L926/L1660 define no-access as: not a member of the Chat bound by chatId, lacking "view" on the channel of a Space-bound call, or blocked by the initiator (ChatContact.blocked). crate-jmap-chat-vtc-server has no function a backend can call from its get_objects/query_objects to decide this; its is_member checks the hosting account owner, not the caller. Add one and list it in the binding's backend-method table. Also note: §Standalone Calls (L1666-1671) admits only participants and the initiator, which by itself leaves no way for a non-participant to join a standalone room call; who may join is deployment-defined (L1652).
